description: Nodes for collections of images, video, audio and rasters added from the Discovery Catalog: sample a video's frames, split recordings into windows with their levels, and mosaic raster tiles into one raster. Each takes the rows Data Loading returns for a collection and returns rows or a raster the other nodes already read.
name: Media

templates.description: Sample frames from every video in a collection, every EVERY_SECONDS seconds. Returns one row per frame with the columns of an image row (path, thumbnail, image_url, width, height), the video's fields and position, and t_s, the frame's offset.
templates.label: Sample Video Frames

templates.description: Split every recording in a collection into windows of WINDOW_SECONDS seconds. Returns one row per window with its level and peak in dBFS, a playable clip, the recording's fields, and t_s, the window's offset.
templates.label: Split Audio

templates.description: Combine a raster collection's tiles, or a filtered set of them, into one virtual mosaic that any RASTER node reads. The tiles must share CRS, resolution, bands and data type.
templates.label: Mosaic Rasters
